about.subtitle: Identity, vision and mission
about.body:
The Rabta is a community association based in Rennes.
It aims to support families, education and social cohesion.
Its vision: a united, educated and engaged Sudanese community.
Its mission: to offer accessible associative, academic and cultural services.

president.subtitle: Message and introduction
president.body: The president represents the Rabta and oversees the overall coordination of the secretariats, the Shura Council and community initiatives.

privacy.subtitle: The Rabta’s public commitment regarding personal data
privacy.p1: The Rabta processes personal data as part of its associative, academic and administrative activities, in line with applicable rules (including the GDPR).
privacy.p2: Data about students, parents and members is collected for specific purposes: enrolment, educational follow-up, community communication and internal management.
privacy.p3: Access to data is limited by roles and permissions. Sensitive information and individual files are never published on the public website.
privacy.p4: For any access, rectification or deletion request, contact the Rabta via the Contact page.
